herosection.title: SHL - Supreme Home Loans: Empowering Rural India Through Smart Digital Transformation

storySection.title: Scenario: Enabling Field-Ready Financial Inclusion in Rural India
paragraphs: Supreme Home Loans (SHL) wanted to make their growing loan distribution network more efficient, connected, and accessible, especially across rural and semi-urban regions of India, where financial inclusion remains a challenge.

The agents were on the go constantly. They were visiting villages, meeting families, collecting loan applications, and doing manual follow-up either through calls or spreadsheets. The traditional method of working made it difficult to track leads and manage commissions and it was hard to ensure the data was even accurate.

Managers typically had no visibility in real time, and agents faced connectivity challenges in rural areas. SHL needed a mobile-first solution that was easy to use that would enable loan processing, connect agents and managers on one platform, and allow rural communities to access loans more simply and transparently.

To bring this idea to life meant finding a mobile development agency that could think beyond technology; they needed a team that could design experiences specifically for the people that needed them most.

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.description: In an effort to make financial access easier for India's underserved rural and semi-urban communities, Supreme Home Loans wanted to modernize its loan distribution network, using technology not as a barrier but as a bridge.

list.text: Growing agents in the network of SHL, working across remote and low-connectivity regions relied on manual paperworks, calls, and spreadsheets.
This old system resulted in data inaccuracies, loan processing delays, and a lack of transparency in real time for managers.
Agents have faced difficulties in tracking leads, managing commissions, and keeping in touch with headquarters, especially while traveling between villages.
SHL required a mobile-first, human-centered, offline-capable platform that eased processes and empowered agents and managers alike.
The deeper challenge was not only digital transformation but also designing technology for people who had never used such systems before, keeping every interaction simple, inclusive, and reliable.

challenge.conclusionLine: In essence, the challenge for SHL was to replace a fragmented and highly manual process with an intelligent and accessible ecosystem that would help bring financial inclusion to rural India, one mobile device at a time.

startageySection.title: THE STRATEGY
startageySection.description: Prakria has taken a very human-centered design approach, based on usability by agents in real-world, low-tech situations. The strategy behind the design was to "make technology invisible"-to make the users focus on their work, not the interface.

list.title: Human-Centered Simplicity
list.description: Designed every interaction so agents can focus on their work, not struggle with the interface; step-by-step, confidence-building processes.

list.title: Mobile-First Ecosystem
list.description: Developed an ecosystem connecting field agents to managers seamlessly, using intuitive dashboards and real-time data syncing.

list.title: Offline Readiness & Inclusion
list.description: Enabled offline workflows, added regional language support, and designed step-by-step forms for inclusivity and easy adoption.

list.title: Manager Visibility & Control
list.description: Created a centralized admin and analytics panel for transparent lead tracking, commission management, and performance insights.

executionSection.title: THE CREATIVE EXECUTION
executionSection.description: Designed a clean, intuitive mobile interface with step-by-step loan forms; integrated offline storage and auto-sync for continuity; and created purpose-built dashboards and analytics for agents and managers—bringing SHL's vision to life with empathy and functional innovation.

list.title: Step-by-Step Loan Forms
list.description: Designed clean, guided forms that ensure clarity and comfort even for first-time users.

list.title: Offline Storage + Auto Sync
list.description: Integrated offline data storage and auto-syncing so agents can continue work without network dependency, ensuring no interruptions or delays.

list.title: Agent Dashboard
list.description: Customized agent dashboard giving visibility into leads, commissions, and key performance metrics—driving motivation and ownership.

list.title: Central Admin & Analytics
list.description: Designed a Central Admin System and real-time analytics so managers can track lead progress and grant approvals smoothly.

list.title: Inclusive Visual System
list.description: Used visual design elements that reflect trust, simplicity, and optimism—with regional language support and lightweight architecture for fast, stable performance in rural contexts.

resultSection.title: The Result
resultSection.description: The launch of SHL transformed how Supreme Home Loans operated, driving financial empowerment where it matters most.

list.text: Faster loan access: Rural agents could now register new leads instantly, cutting down processing time drastically.
Offline continuity: Agents could continue their work without network dependency,  no interruptions, no delays.
Better transparency: Managers gained complete visibility into lead progress, agent performance, and payouts.
Increased trust: Borrowers experienced faster responses, clearer updates, and more reliable communication.
Empowered workforce: Agents felt supported with digital tools that helped them serve their customers better.

By combining simplicity, empathy, and technology, Prakria - one of the best web developers in the industry - helped SHL make loan access faster, fairer, and more inclusive across India’s rural communities.
